description: Search commercial deep-fryer parts by part number, specification string or keyword (e.g. 'RX thermostat 24 in capillary', '00-419670-00001', '5500 W element', '炸炉恒温器'). Returns matching records with the canonical page URL, plus matching guides and part-vs-part comparisons when the query is a decision question ('can I use A instead of B', '5500 W or 8500 W'). This is a reference index, not a store: there are no prices or stock levels. Use get_part afterwards when you need specifications for one record.

query.description: Part number, spec string or keyword (English or Chinese).

title: Search fryer parts
